action_instruction: Counting Read a book rows in the todo list
intent: the count of todo-list rows whose label is Read a book

action_params.condition: Exactly one row in the todo list reads "Read a book".
action_params.query: the count of todo-list rows whose label is Read a book

action_instruction: Checking the final row of the todo list
intent: whether the last row in the todo list is labeled Read a book

action_params.condition: The row reading "Read a book" is the last row of the todo list.
action_params.query: whether the last row in the todo list is labeled Read a book

action_instruction: Checking the footer position below the final todo row
intent: whether the 3 items left footer content is positioned immediately below the final Read a book todo row with no later todo row

action_params.condition: The footer with "3 items left" sits directly below the "Read a book" row with no other todo row in between.
action_params.query: whether the 3 items left footer content is positioned immediately below the final Read a book todo row with no later todo row
action_params.code_js: (() => { const last = el(9).lastElementChild; const rowBox = last?.getBoundingClientRect(); const countBox = el(20).getBoundingClientRect(); return last?.querySelector('label')?.textContent.trim() === 'Read a book' && rowBox != null && countBox.top >= rowBox.bottom && [...el(9).querySelectorAll('li')].slice(-1)[0] === last; })()

assertion_tree.description: exactly one row in the todo list reads "Read a book", it is the last row of the list, and the footer with "3 items left" sits directly below it with no other todo row in between

sub_results.description: Exactly one row in the todo list reads "Read a book".

The footer with "3 items left" sits directly below the "Read a book" row with no other todo row in between.
